definitions.gloss: health resort; retreat; rest area; convalescence destination
definitions.explanation: A place where people go to rest, recuperate, or improve their health, typically in a natural setting with clean air, hot springs, or other therapeutic amenities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保養地|ほようち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: To spend time at a mountain retreat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{軽井沢|かるいざわ}→軽井沢：30713_karuizawa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{保養地|ほようち}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Karuizawa has been known as a health resort since long ago.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{保養地|ほようち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{心身|しんしん}→心身：04206_shinshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦リフレッシュ→リフレッシュ：11261_rifuresshu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I refreshed my body and mind at a resort with hot springs.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{保養|ほよう}→保養：11574_hoyou⟧ (rest, recuperation) + {地|ち} (place). Refers to destinations valued for their restorative qualities — clean mountain air, hot springs, quiet seaside settings, etc. Many Japanese companies and organizations maintain {保養所|ほようじょ} (rest facilities) for employees.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧{保養地|ほようち}: hot spring resort
- ⟦{高原|こうげん}→高原：05497_kougen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保養地|ほようち}: highland retreat
- ⟦{海辺|うみべ}→海辺：05498_umibe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保養地|ほようち}: seaside resort
- {保養地|ほようち}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{発展|はってん}する→発展する：25331_hattensuru⟧: to develop as a health resort

RELATED WORDS:
- {保養所|ほようじょ}: rest facility, retreat house — a specific building or facility (often company-owned)
- ⟦{避暑地|ひしょち}→避暑地：16506_hishochi⟧: summer retreat — a place to escape summer heat
- {湯治場|とうじば}: hot spring cure site — a place specifically for therapeutic bathing
- ⟦リゾート→リゾート：11394_rizooto⟧: resort — the loanword, more associated with leisure than health
